tiles.description: Pokemon-center style front facade (7x5 tiles). Large exterior building front for town hubs; place as an object aligned to a street doorway.
Narrow wall/roof facade strip with window-door rhythm (5x4). Use as a compact storefront or side facade segment.
House facade with slanted pink roof (5x4). Standard residential exterior for town neighborhoods.
Stone plaza patch (4x4). Walkable ground fill for courtyards, ruins, and rocky streets.
Round canopy tree (3x4). Solid obstacle tree for parks, city medians, and forest edges.
Pink blossom tree (2x3). Decorative obstacle tree for gardens and spring-themed routes.
Cross-path dirt junction (3x2). Use where horizontal and vertical paths intersect.
Vertical banner/sign post (1x3). Tall decorative marker for gates, plazas, and landmarks.
Pokeball-themed bed (3x3). Bedroom furniture obstacle for houses and guest rooms.
Tall wardrobe cabinet (2x4). Indoor storage furniture intended for wall placement.
Bookshelf block (3x3). Interior wall furniture for studies, libraries, and bedrooms.
Wide desk/table variant A (3x3). Indoor obstacle piece for offices and lounge areas.
Wide desk/table variant B (3x3). Companion variant to mix with desk2a in interior layouts.
Table-and-wall-art furniture strip (4x3). Use for decorated rooms, galleries, or lobby interiors.
